content.comment_body: Hello, Currently, I am using a [product_name] with [article_no] to read two PT100 sensors. I would like to switch to the new [product_name] [version_no] for its webserver and data logging features. In the specifications for the expansion modules of [version_no], I see that [article_no] is required for reading PT100 sensors. Can you clarify why the older [article_no] cannot be used, or if connecting the previous version is still possible? Regards, [user_name]

The new [product_name] [version_no] differs entirely from earlier versions up to [version_no]. The [version_no] only functions with expansion modules from its own series, and is not compatible with previous series expansion modules. Likewise, earlier [product_name] versions up to [version_no] cannot use expansion modules designed for the new series. The part numbers for new expansion modules end with [article_no], whereas for the operator device it is [article_no]. Edit: See this page for a list of part numbers related to the new series: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants discuss challenges with compatibility between expansion modules and different hardware versions of [product_name]. The motivation to upgrade for advanced features like webserver and data logging is hindered by changes in module compatibility across versions, causing confusion regarding correct part numbers and increasing the risk of purchasing incompatible components.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate either backward compatibility or clear guidance about interoperability between legacy expansion modules and the latest [product_name] hardware series for maintaining similar functionality.
